data.body: Design implication (operator-directed): budget exhaustion currently pressures agents into an ANTI-PATTERN — tagging code-verifiable criteria [operator-attested] to bypass the exhausted search (observed in both incidents in the prior comment; both were wrong to tag). This strengthens the case for the evidence_sufficient:false marker: exhaustion must be visibly a verifier-capacity outcome prompting re-verify (or evidence-citation in untagged comments), never a prompt to launder repo-provable criteria into attestations. Remediation text for marker-carrying FAILs should say exactly that: re-verify after making evidence discoverable; do NOT tag code-verifiable criteria as operator-attested.
